blocks.text: Histograms qeematon ko khanon (bins) ya faslon mein jama kar ke dikhate hain ke har khane mein kitni qeematein aati hain, yaani data ki taqseem, maslan students ke maths exam scores kaise phaile hain.

blocks.prompt: Das scores 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70, 88 ko 50s, 60s, 70s, 80s aur 90s ke khanon mein rakhein.
blocks.explanation: 50s: 1; 60s: 2; 70s: 2; 80s: 3; 90s: 2. 80s ka khana sab se uncha hai.

items: Histogram: har khane mein kitni qeematein; taqseem ki shakal dikhata hai.
